programme.desc: For their fourth full movie Temporary Autonomy Zone the Gpsy Feelin’ boys focus on the riders’ life in a society that destroys him more than it helps him.

programme.title: The Long Hope
programme.desc: A top climber attempts a historic one-day ascent of a legendary sea cliff, while the story revisits the original first ascent 40 years earlier, contrasting extreme modern climbing with the legacy of a pioneering climber returning one last time.

programme.title: Tomorrow Will Be Better
programme.desc: Czech freestyle motocross star Libor Podmol is proof that the wildest dreams come true. In January, 2010 he flies to the US, buys a Suzuki 250 two-stroke, becomes 6 times world champ and signs a sponsorship deal with Rockstar Energy.

programme.title: California Republic
programme.desc: No other place offers such endless freedom while fueling surfing's evolution. California's blue skies, green waters, and landscapes inspire millions worldwide and shape global culture.

programme.title: Peace and Left II
programme.desc: A Basque freesurfer documents a five-month journey through Indonesia, traveling with family, friends, and alone, capturing his surf adventure on camera.

programme.title: All Or Nothing
programme.desc: A self-supported project celebrating two-wheel sports, filmed across Europe, featuring young talents and world-class riders in MTB, trials, BMX, and motorsports.

programme.title: Because
programme.desc: A high-end freeski documentary following 22 professional athletes across record snowfall winters, facing deep powder, massive cliffs, and extreme expeditions, while sharing their ambition, discipline, and drive to reach the next level of their careers.

programme.title: Begging For Change
programme.desc: This movie is about the lives of strange and exhilarating men, begging for change, and living a life that is fast, cheap, and affordable. All the things that make up a great ski movie

programme.title: Chaiyo Premiere Tour
programme.desc: A skate documentary following a 10-day tour across Thailand, featuring demos and premieres in several cities, capturing the energy of local skate scenes and the passion of skaters coming together to celebrate.

programme.title: Dalua Downhill
programme.desc: This is the journey of Douglas Rodrigues da Silva, aka “Dalua”, who is in search of the Downhill Skateboard world championship. This sport is among the most dangerous in the world where the skaters go downhill reaching speeds over 110 km/h. Over the course of two years, the film follows the Brazilian athlete in his travels around the world revealing that beyond the competition there is a story of determination, passion, pressure and pain. Friendship and rivalry awake some rowdy feelings between the athletes. It is this common bond between them that also what keeps them apart.

programme.title: En Route America
programme.desc: A road trip across the West Coast, following skiers as they explore iconic mountains and chase winter conditions across the United States.

programme.title: En Route Departure
programme.desc: Follow Pep Fujas, Blake Nyman, Anthony Boronowski, Dylan Hood, Eric Pollard, Chris Benchetler and more as they chase storms from a Top Secret Military Mountain Warfare Facility, to the Italian Alps.

programme.title: Falling Angels
programme.desc: Three female BASE jumpers trek deep into the Venezuelan jungle to attempt a historic jump from the world’s highest waterfall, facing extreme terrain, technical challenges, and one of the most dangerous exits in the sport.

programme.title: Gunnie Season
programme.desc: An extreme skiing film featuring some of the world’s top professional skiers pushing their limits on snow and steep terrain.

programme.title: Peace and Left
programme.desc: A surf series following Hugues Oyarzabal, capturing spectacular first-person barrel footage at iconic spots around the globe, offering a rare inside view of high-performance surfing.

programme.title: Pour Vous Servir
programme.desc: Or At Your Service in English takes you to the heart of the action, and most of all makes you feel how riders and cameramen share the same emotions. Like a collection of short stories, the movie tells how they live together and share the joys and the hassles of the everyday, the trips, the exhaustion, the laughter...

programme.title: The South To Sian Journals
programme.desc: While filming South To Sian, a pair of adventurers dived into what began as a three-month trip and turned into a two-year odyssey of exploration.On boards, bikes, by boat and four-wheel drive, Harrison Roach and Zye Norris discovered if, in these days of GPS and WiFi, the dream of a true pioneering surf adventure is still alive.South to Sian Journals is a collection of stories documenting the people, places & adventures that occurred during the 2 years making “South To Sian” - the challenges, the surfers, riders, shapers, bike builders, filmmakers and photographers.Extremely entertaining and insightful, “Journals” documents the travels, the hardships, the spectacular locations, the personalities and the thoughts of the characters, both in front of and behind the lens.

programme.title: Perilous Sea
programme.desc: Perilous Sea is a transcontinental cold-water surfing odyssey capturing the raw spirit, glorious landscapes and pure perfection that arises when conditions align. This incredible story creates moments of cold-water nirvana that rival any across the globe.Inspired by the storytelling style of classic ocean-fairing novels, Perilous Sea follows a group of surfers as they explore the landscapes and waves of the North Atlantic fringes. From the Canadian Maritimes, north to Iceland and beyond to the wave rich coast of Ireland, this award-winning film takes us on a journey to the world of surf.Follow them into the water as they dare to get into the treacherous waters that have taken the lives of many in Perilous Sea: a story of overcoming challenges and spirituality.

programme.title: Rolex New York Yacht Invitational Cup - Highlight
Wind Masters - Episode 6: Zadar, Nin, Iž, Olib, Silba, Premuda, Molat, Pag
Ciuri Ciuri
programme.desc: Sicily, the largest Mediterranean island and just off the “toe” of Italy’s “boot” is the destination chosen this time by our Nautical Hosts Andi and Chelsey as they head to the South of Italy to meet up with renowned Sicilian sailors.Its rich history is not only reflected in their cuisine and culture, but also on their sailing techniques that balance tradition with modern skills. They will discover the coastlines near Palermo to learn how to tack and jibe and of course will try the delicious Sicilian cuisine.Join Andi and Chelsey on their journey around Sicily learning about sailing and tasting traditional dishes in Ciuri Ciuri, exclusive on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Inside Superyachts - Episode 5
programme.desc: Arguably, a superyacht is the most glamorous holiday you can take. Burgess yachts, the largest yacht broker in the world, talks to us about the process of owning and/or chartering your very own yacht.We take a look at just how yachts are marketed and meet with Australian Shipbuilders Silver Yachts, who achieved the amazing feat of getting a Mercedes car onto their Yacht Silver Fast for one of the most epic yachts commercials ever.For those wanting more than a charter, but don’t want to own a boat outright, we introduce them to MAHA Yachts, a brand new concept bridging the gap between Charter and Sales – a unique collaboration with the world leading hotelier Adrian Zecha from Aman Hotels and Feadship.We sign off with one last adventure underwater, exploring the sea with Deep Flight and Rainbow Fish, interviewing Dr. Xin Wu who is helping to pioneer deep water tourism.

programme.title: Inside Superyachts - Episode 6
programme.desc: In the latest episode of Inside Superyachts we interview Ken Freivokh, designer of some of the world’s most iconic yachts and concepts ever. Besides talking to the genius behind some of the best yacht masterpieces we meet with Thirty C leading CGI concept designers.Lastly, we know that no yacht would be complete without a vessel to get you to and from shore. Pascoe Tenders open their doors to us to have a look inside these space-aged, hyperluxurious tenders.

programme.title: Second Life In Scandinavia
programme.desc: Hello from Sweden!We are on our way to the island of Orust. This island lives from boatbuilding, and big companies produce sailing boats here to expand their boats to the entire world. When the economic crisis stroke, demand decreased, thus less boats were ordered. This forced habitants of the small island of Orust to find a new path.Refit has become the new trend in Second Life in Scandinavia. Giving a new life to beautiful yachts, not only the economy is changing, but the local community as well. Lucia will venture into the island of Orust to learn more about the way its population has adapted and how it has become the mecca of boatbuilding.Watch out now, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Salon Nautique Paris - 2015
programme.desc: Among the world's greatest boat shows, Salon Nautique in Paris is back! Join Nico Peduzzi at the prestigious Port de Versailles and discover this year's hottest innovations in sailing, motorboats, board sports, equipment, tourism and more.

programme.title: Jump On Board - Episode 6
programme.desc: Mia has left the girls behind and we are reaching the sad ending of our trip. The crew sail from Skiros to Lavrion before Abi and Zita say their goodbyes to Georgios. Then, we recollect the best moments we have experienced in the Greek Islands with our two winners.

This incredible story creates moments of cold-water nirvana that rival any across the globe.Inspired by the storytelling style of classic ocean-fairing novels, Perilous Sea follows a group of surfers as they explore the landscapes and waves of the North Atlantic fringes. From the Canadian Maritimes, north to Iceland and beyond to the wave rich coast of Ireland, this award-winning film takes us on a journey to the world of surf.Follow them into the water as they dare to get into the treacherous waters that have taken the lives of many in Perilous Sea: a story of overcoming challenges and spirituality.

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise - Ep.4 - ŠIBENIK - MURTER
Skeleton Sea
programme.desc: João and Xandi, two surfers in their early 50′s, have been working together for 25 years. They clean beaches and with the trash they pick they create the most stunning artwork. However, living as an artist and idealist in Portugal is not economically profitable and, therefore, not easy.Their family life is affected by the choices they make and their wish to raise awareness about the ever-growing pollution in our oceans. Skeleton Sea takes us on their personal journey to help people understand the importance of our oceans to help us take the step to change our habits to keep them clean. As all live comes from the sea, Skeleton Sea reminds us that this powerful force has the ability of taking it away from us as well.

programme.title: The Road To Bermuda - Episode 1
programme.desc: In this first episode of Road to Bermuda we meet the man who decided to take the America's Cup to Bermuda and explore some of sailing's most complex challenges. Also, the famous skipper Jimmy Spithill will share his experience on the island with us. Watch this and more on The Road to Bermuda!

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 8 - Pag – Rab
programme.desc: In this episode we visit the magnificent islands of Pag and Rab and enjoy wonderful local gastronomy. Did you know that word salary originates from the latin word salarium which means salt? In Roman times, soldiers got their pay in salt!

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 9 - Rijeka – Opatija
programme.desc: In this episode we are taking you to Kvarner and to the biggest Croatian port – Rijeka. We are going to visit some very special places in Opatija including a sweet world of chocolate!

programme.title: Inside Vienna - Imperial City Meets Nautical Sports
programme.desc: Welcome to Vienna!Austria’s capital, lying by the Danube River and known for its artistic and intellectual legacy shaped by residents as Mozart, Beethoven or Sigmund Freud amongst others. Vienna is a city known for its tradition, but has also become the scene for modern nautical sports that are shifting the world of water sports.From meeting the Austrian Olympic rowing team to freestyle kayaking and a rendezvous with the local Gondola Club, host Lucia Metzbauer is on a quest to discover the nautical sports and athletes of Vienna. She is set for a challenge as she sails across all the different sport options in the city.Become part of the Vienna scenery and discover the water sports this city has to offer from the side of Lucia Metzbauer, on Inside Vienna – Imperial City Meets Nautical Sports.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup - Sprint 2 World Cup Duisburg
programme.desc: Welcome to Duisburg in Germany! The World Cup 2 of the 2018 season is being disputed, and athletes from all over the world are pitching themselves in one of the most beautiful settings we have on the circuit. Kayaks, canoes, singles, doubles and fours... all are fighting to go to the Olympic Games in Tokyo in two years time. Let's see where they are at the moment! Discover the best action of the weekend's regatta in Duisburg.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup - Sprint 3 World Cup Montemor
programme.desc: In this third stage of the competition we are in Montemor-o-Velho, in Portugal. This is the 2018 ICF Sprint World Championships, where 676 athletes from 66 nations are ready to give everything they have and raise with the title. The weather is perfect and the organization is perfect. Will the athletes be up to standards in this awaited event? Let's look back at the best of the action over the past four days of competition.

programme.title: Wind Masters - Episode 6: Zadar, Nin, Iž, Olib, Silba, Premuda, Molat, Pag
Ciuri Ciuri
programme.desc: Sicily, the largest Mediterranean island and just off the “toe” of Italy’s “boot” is the destination chosen this time by our Nautical Hosts Andi and Chelsey as they head to the South of Italy to meet up with renowned Sicilian sailors.Its rich history is not only reflected in their cuisine and culture, but also on their sailing techniques that balance tradition with modern skills. They will discover the coastlines near Palermo to learn how to tack and jibe and of course will try the delicious Sicilian cuisine.Join Andi and Chelsey on their journey around Sicily learning about sailing and tasting traditional dishes in Ciuri Ciuri, exclusive on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Second Life In Scandinavia
programme.desc: Hello from Sweden!We are on our way to the island of Orust. This island lives from boatbuilding, and big companies produce sailing boats here to expand their boats to the entire world. When the economic crisis stroke, demand decreased, thus less boats were ordered. This forced habitants of the small island of Orust to find a new path.Refit has become the new trend in Second Life in Scandinavia. Giving a new life to beautiful yachts, not only the economy is changing, but the local community as well. Lucia will venture into the island of Orust to learn more about the way its population has adapted and how it has become the mecca of boatbuilding.Watch out now, on Nautical Channel.

Qatar Airways GKA Kite World Tour Magazines - Episode 1
Baltic Sea Goes Sup
programme.desc: What SUP Baltic Sea?Considered a hidden gem for many years, the Baltic Sea is now a retreat for water sports practitioners. People from different parts of the world and cultures join the mesmerising background of the Baltic Sea to practice surfing, sailing and most importantly of all, SUP!Join the worldwide phenomenon of Standup Paddleboarding (SUP) that originated in Hawaii and has finally reached the Baltic Sea.Now available on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: The Boat Show - Episode 5
programme.desc: Built by one of the oldest boat yards, the Baglietto MV 19 is a classic yet modern boat. We will try it out first before boarding the Ranieri 220SH and trying on the water the Solaris 47, an evolution of the 58 and the 50 with features for a reduced crew. Let's jump onboard!

programme.title: The Boat Show - Episode 6
programme.desc: In today's episode of The Boat Show we start in Greece to test a boat built by BSK Marine, the BSK Marine Skipper 4X 90. Then, we jump on board the Solaris 42 a boat designed by Soto Acebal. Finally, we try on the water the Capelli 50, a boat with almost 15 meters long and powered by four 425 horsepower outboards.

Wild Surf - Episode 1
programme.desc: In this episode of Wild Surf, we’re going to take a look at Walking the Waves - a short film by italian freesurfer Eugenio Barcelloni exploring the best surfing beaches in Chile, Peru and Tahiti, featuring the best surfers, and focusing on the natural scenery each country has to offer, we’ll be getting acquainted with the culture and the landscapes.

programme.title: Wild Surf - Episode 2
programme.desc: In this episode, we take a look at ‘Cross Culture Surf’, a pioneering cultural exchange between the Basque country and Ireland. Then we’re off to sunny California, where David Barr showcases an amazing new technology, allowing surfers to customize their ride. Then we’re checking out and up and coming contender in the UK surf scene.

programme.title: Beneath the Surface
programme.desc: Big wave surfer Andrew Cotton, a plumber and father of two from Devon, hit the headlines in 2014 when it was rumoured that he had surfed the world’s biggest wave, estimated at 80ft. In this one-off 30-minute documentary, Andrew and his team of surfers, sailors and adventurers put everything on hold as they secretly chase a wave that emerges only a handful of times each year, giving only hours of warning.Taking a boat eight miles off the coast of Ireland, the team battle the extreme cold and fierce weather conditions, whilst mapping the ocean’s swell, in order to try to catch one almighty ride. Far from home and with the days getting shorter, frustration sets in, as the window of opportunity gets smaller. With a young family at home, Andrew must balance the normality of the school run, before boarding a plane alone to face one of earth’s deadliest monsters.

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise - Ep.5 - DUGI OTOK
Paddling across Borders
programme.desc: Our expedition begins in the Klopeinersee, a journey that leads us into two countries - Slovenia and Austria. We're going to meet people whom the cold, fog and snow in winter does not keep them away from spending every day at the water. The Klopeinersee has many opportunities to get active in the water. We will dive into a unique location in Europe, the 2125 metre-high Petzen mountain, to do watersports! Join Nautical Channel's hosts Lucia Metzbauer as she meets locals on both sides of the boarder who are crazy about their boats even in sub-zero temperatures, above and below the ground. We are going Paddling across Borders!

programme.title: VOR Identity
programme.desc: The Volvo Ocean Race visits 10 cities around the world making it the ultimate test for sailors around the world. Often described as the longest and toughest professional sporting event in the world, it is one of the sport’s Big Three events, alongside the Olympic Games and America’s Cup.However, to truly understand the race, it is better to think about the athletes who take part of it. Meet the teams and the superstars in Alicante on the eve of their quest to the Volvo Ocean Race. They share the same obsession for the sea, and many of them have fully dedicated themselves for years, even decades trying to win.Map the racecourse, get the latest intel on the boats and the tech and above all, find out what really moves the action of heroes from modern day offshore sailing. Watch it now, on Nautical Channel and become part of this sailing frenzy.

programme.title: Inside Sailing - Episode 10
programme.desc: We will start from USA, New York where one of the most historic clubs in the world, New York Yacht Club hosted its biennial regatta, the Rolex New York Yacht Club Invitational Cup. Then, we move to Asia for one of the most important events of 470 class, the 2019 470 World Championship.Finally, ending our trip around the world we will take you to St. Petersburg in Russia for the 2019 RS:X Youth World Championship where over 100 competitors from all over the world have gathered to claim the title.

programme.title: GKA Kite World Tour Summaries - Episode 6
Clipper: The Race Of Their Lives - Episode 1
programme.desc: Welcome to the eleventh edition of the biennial race of Clipper: The Race of Their Lives. 700 participants representing over 40 nations will take on the challenge of dealing with whatever 'Mother Nature' has in store. They will battle the elements out on the world's greatest oceans and will experiences the toughest conditions imaginable: from hurricane force winds to squalls that can knock a boat flat. Find out now what will happen in this unique challenge.

We will be talking you through the action of this competition: it is going to be canoe single men followed by the kayak single women. Follow us for slalom competition at its highest level. Relive the best moments in Lee Valley 2019.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup - Slalom 2 World Cup Bratislava
programme.desc: Welcome to Bratislava, in Slovakia, for round two of the 2019 ICF Canoe Slalom World Cup. Mallory Franklin, Kimberley Woods and Jessica Fox were the top three in Lee Valley last weekend, however Mallory Franklin and Kimberley Woods will not be racing this weekend while Jessica Fox got eliminated in the semi-final. In the C1 men's the medalists from last weekend will also not be racing here, but there are some big names in the lineup. Let's dive into the action in Bratislava.

programme.title: Wind Masters - Episode 6: Zadar, Nin, Iž, Olib, Silba, Premuda, Molat, Pag
Ciuri Ciuri
programme.desc: Sicily, the largest Mediterranean island and just off the “toe” of Italy’s “boot” is the destination chosen this time by our Nautical Hosts Andi and Chelsey as they head to the South of Italy to meet up with renowned Sicilian sailors.Its rich history is not only reflected in their cuisine and culture, but also on their sailing techniques that balance tradition with modern skills. They will discover the coastlines near Palermo to learn how to tack and jibe and of course will try the delicious Sicilian cuisine.Join Andi and Chelsey on their journey around Sicily learning about sailing and tasting traditional dishes in Ciuri Ciuri, exclusive on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Beneath the Surface
programme.desc: Big wave surfer Andrew Cotton, a plumber and father of two from Devon, hit the headlines in 2014 when it was rumoured that he had surfed the world’s biggest wave, estimated at 80ft. In this one-off 30-minute documentary, Andrew and his team of surfers, sailors and adventurers put everything on hold as they secretly chase a wave that emerges only a handful of times each year, giving only hours of warning.Taking a boat eight miles off the coast of Ireland, the team battle the extreme cold and fierce weather conditions, whilst mapping the ocean’s swell, in order to try to catch one almighty ride. Far from home and with the days getting shorter, frustration sets in, as the window of opportunity gets smaller. With a young family at home, Andrew must balance the normality of the school run, before boarding a plane alone to face one of earth’s deadliest monsters.

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise - Ep.5 - DUGI OTOK
VOR Identity
programme.desc: The Volvo Ocean Race visits 10 cities around the world making it the ultimate test for sailors around the world. Often described as the longest and toughest professional sporting event in the world, it is one of the sport’s Big Three events, alongside the Olympic Games and America’s Cup.However, to truly understand the race, it is better to think about the athletes who take part of it. Meet the teams and the superstars in Alicante on the eve of their quest to the Volvo Ocean Race. They share the same obsession for the sea, and many of them have fully dedicated themselves for years, even decades trying to win.Map the racecourse, get the latest intel on the boats and the tech and above all, find out what really moves the action of heroes from modern day offshore sailing. Watch it now, on Nautical Channel and become part of this sailing frenzy.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 8 - Pag – Rab
programme.desc: In this episode we visit the magnificent islands of Pag and Rab and enjoy wonderful local gastronomy. Did you know that word salary originates from the latin word salarium which means salt? In Roman times, soldiers got their pay in salt!

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 9 - Rijeka – Opatija
programme.desc: In this episode we are taking you to Kvarner and to the biggest Croatian port – Rijeka. We are going to visit some very special places in Opatija including a sweet world of chocolate!

programme.title: GKA Kite World Tour Summaries - Episode 6
Wind Masters - Episode 7: Novalja, NP Plitvička jezera, Rijeka, Opatija
Inside Kiel - Sailing Capital and more
programme.desc: Kiel is the nautical epicentre of Germany, and the proud host of the world's biggest sailing event, the Kieler Woche. From learning how to sail a Formula18 catamaran to exploring local kitesurf spots and shipyards, Nautical Channel host Lucia Metzbauer will be there, diving into the local nautical scene and finding out why there are so many young sailors in Kiel.Join her in Kieler Woche, one of the largest sailing events in the world. With regattas sailing at the highest level and an unbeatable class diversity, entertainment is secured as we learn everything about this German event that drives the attention of sailors worldwide.

programme.title: Screen Heroes - Episode 1
programme.desc: In this first episode of Screen Heroes, you can expect some insights in the world of surfing cinema. Today we are in Hamburg, Germany, to check out Hamburg's annual Surf and Skate Festival. Then, we will be taking you to California where we will feature the San Diego Surf Film Festival. Let's go!

programme.title: Ocean Safari - Kenya - Episode 1
programme.desc: Andi is on a mission to discover the Tana River, Kenya’s longest river with a unique rapids system. In order to truly experience this region of the Tana, Andi has to learn to navigate the waters on a kayak. She tracks down river expert and professional Kayaker Kris Collyer and challenges him to learn his skill in three days. Andi is tested when she almost drowns trying to complete her mission.

programme.title: Reaching Reality - Episode 1 - Origin
programme.desc: From under the Golden Gate Bridge down to the Santa Cruz Islands the three friends and their little boat are now heading south. However bad weather is on the horizon and signs that the film and the filmmaker are already thinking about abandoning ship are starting to leak through. After a long night of sea sickness, it’s time to face reality and see who’s going to stick around and who’s going to go.

programme.title: Reaching Reality - Episode 2 - Reality
programme.desc: Now closing in on Mexico and having spent nearly a month at sea, the crew are facing some realities they didn’t expect. It’s cold, it’s wet, and its nothing like what they were hoping. Adding to the chaos, Barry is emotionally lost and opens up about what he left behind to go on this trip. As the crew pokes around Catalina Island and down into Mexico a reckoning with what the trip is and what they wanted it to be is on the horizon and with it a new reality of life.

programme.title: Salon Nautique Paris - 2016
programme.desc: By the industry and the financial world as a whole it's considered one of the most important venues in the field. For the passionate French public it's an absolute must to prepare for next year's season on the water. There's just no other place like the Paris Nautic, because France is possibly the greatest boating nation on the planet. Expected in the thousands starting on Saturday December the third until the following weekend, fans will be storming the pavillions of Porte de Versailles looking for the latest innovations and the best possible deal.

programme.title: Jump On Board - Episode 1
programme.desc: Welcome to our new adventure of Jump on Board! We are with Abi and our captain Marcos, and we will be sailing the Ionian Islands with the new girls: Cindy, Caitlin and Linda. The islands are known for their pristine clear blue waters, strong wind and unspoiled nature. Are you jumping on board with us?

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise - Ep.5 - DUGI OTOK
SXM Best Weekend
programme.desc: Ready for the best weekend of your lives? The SXM Best Weekend is one of the most anticipated Caribbean summer events of the year. A local group of young brothers and musicians called “The Red Eye Crew” decided to revolutionize the party scenario in these paradisiac islands. That is why they brought a party wave onto St. Maarten.Follow their crazy adventure as they organize this explosive event and share their inspiring story on how they came up with this idea and what drives them. A fun journey for party lovers, SXM Best Weekend will have you put your hands up and enjoy the queens of Caribbean music with blasting performances from Haitian rapper Wyclef Jean.Party your way around the Caribbean rhythm, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: The Road To Bermuda - Episode 2
programme.desc: In this seasonal special, we’ll be catching up with SoftBank Team Japan and Oracle Team USA to find out exactly what they have on their Christmas wish lists this year. Rachel will also be cooking up a local holiday speciality and sampling it to the AC teams, as well as getting her dancing shoes on with the local Gombeys!

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 10 - Losinj – Istria
programme.desc: We have arrived at the beautiful islands of Cres and Lošinj where we will explore amazing places and learn how to cook buzara (Buzara is Croatian way of cooking mussels with only few simple ingredients. This easy mussels recipe is popular along the Dalmatian coast). We will also sail over to Istria and the magical islands of Brijuni.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 1 - Dubrovnik – Lastovo
programme.desc: (A new season of Sail-Ho! Croatia brings you the most fascinating destinations on the Croatian coast. Breathtaking landscapes, untouched nature, exquisite cuisine, no wonder Croatia is by many considered to be a true Hedonist Paradise.) We start at the southernmost part of the Croatian Coast - the old city of Dubrovnik. We will reveal you some secrets and show you some interesting attractions. After Dubrovnik, we set our sail towards mystical island of Lastovo that was until recently a navy stronghold.

programme.title: What the Sea Gives me
programme.desc: What The Sea Gives Me is a feature length documentary comprised of intimate & candid interviews with some of the ocean’s most extraordinary ambassadors including Great White shark researcher Brett McBride, artist Matt Beard, photographer Chris Burkard, bodysurfer Angie Oschmann, conservationist Jean-Michelle Cousteau, free-diver Herbert Nitsch. We give you an honest and personal look through the eyes of those who thrive under the most extreme water conditions, those ensuring the proper care of the oceans for future generations and those who simply derive a sense of pure joy from the sea.

programme.desc: Kiel is the nautical epicentre of Germany, and the proud host of the world's biggest sailing event, the Kieler Woche. From learning how to sail a Formula18 catamaran to exploring local kitesurf spots and shipyards, Nautical Channel host Lucia Metzbauer will be there, diving into the local nautical scene and finding out why there are so many young sailors in Kiel.Join her in Kieler Woche, one of the largest sailing events in the world. With regattas sailing at the highest level and an unbeatable class diversity, entertainment is secured as we learn everything about this German event that drives the attention of sailors worldwide.

programme.title: Reaching Reality - Episode 1 - Origin
programme.desc: From under the Golden Gate Bridge down to the Santa Cruz Islands the three friends and their little boat are now heading south. However bad weather is on the horizon and signs that the film and the filmmaker are already thinking about abandoning ship are starting to leak through. After a long night of sea sickness, it’s time to face reality and see who’s going to stick around and who’s going to go.

programme.title: Reaching Reality - Episode 2 - Reality
programme.desc: Now closing in on Mexico and having spent nearly a month at sea, the crew are facing some realities they didn’t expect. It’s cold, it’s wet, and its nothing like what they were hoping. Adding to the chaos, Barry is emotionally lost and opens up about what he left behind to go on this trip. As the crew pokes around Catalina Island and down into Mexico a reckoning with what the trip is and what they wanted it to be is on the horizon and with it a new reality of life.

programme.title: GKA Kite World Tour Summaries - Episode 6
VOR Identity
programme.desc: The Volvo Ocean Race visits 10 cities around the world making it the ultimate test for sailors around the world. Often described as the longest and toughest professional sporting event in the world, it is one of the sport’s Big Three events, alongside the Olympic Games and America’s Cup.However, to truly understand the race, it is better to think about the athletes who take part of it. Meet the teams and the superstars in Alicante on the eve of their quest to the Volvo Ocean Race. They share the same obsession for the sea, and many of them have fully dedicated themselves for years, even decades trying to win.Map the racecourse, get the latest intel on the boats and the tech and above all, find out what really moves the action of heroes from modern day offshore sailing. Watch it now, on Nautical Channel and become part of this sailing frenzy.

programme.title: Beneath the Surface
programme.desc: Big wave surfer Andrew Cotton, a plumber and father of two from Devon, hit the headlines in 2014 when it was rumoured that he had surfed the world’s biggest wave, estimated at 80ft. In this one-off 30-minute documentary, Andrew and his team of surfers, sailors and adventurers put everything on hold as they secretly chase a wave that emerges only a handful of times each year, giving only hours of warning.Taking a boat eight miles off the coast of Ireland, the team battle the extreme cold and fierce weather conditions, whilst mapping the ocean’s swell, in order to try to catch one almighty ride. Far from home and with the days getting shorter, frustration sets in, as the window of opportunity gets smaller. With a young family at home, Andrew must balance the normality of the school run, before boarding a plane alone to face one of earth’s deadliest monsters.

Sail-Ho - Episode 10 - Losinj – Istria
programme.desc: We have arrived at the beautiful islands of Cres and Lošinj where we will explore amazing places and learn how to cook buzara (Buzara is Croatian way of cooking mussels with only few simple ingredients. This easy mussels recipe is popular along the Dalmatian coast). We will also sail over to Istria and the magical islands of Brijuni.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 1 - Dubrovnik – Lastovo
programme.desc: (A new season of Sail-Ho! Croatia brings you the most fascinating destinations on the Croatian coast. Breathtaking landscapes, untouched nature, exquisite cuisine, no wonder Croatia is by many considered to be a true Hedonist Paradise.) We start at the southernmost part of the Croatian Coast - the old city of Dubrovnik. We will reveal you some secrets and show you some interesting attractions. After Dubrovnik, we set our sail towards mystical island of Lastovo that was until recently a navy stronghold.

programme.title: Bora Bora: Paddling Paradise
programme.desc: In Bora Bora: Paddling Paradise Nikolai visits the crystal blue lagoons, encounters sharks and stingrays and witnesses the 6th edition of the Muramur surfski race in Tahiti. The intensive 38 km race meandering through reefs that surround the mystic island of Bora Bora is bound to make you pack your flippers and book a flight to the exotic French Polynesia.You can now watch this exclusive show that will take you to one of the world’s most beautiful sceneries on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Chasing Jaguars
programme.desc: A group of brave kayakers get on a plane and fly all the way from Europe to Costa Rica looking for exciting adventures and fast rapids. In Chasing Jaguars, this group of friends will discover the nature and wildlife of the Costa Rican Whitewater paradise.This unforgettable kayak-experience in Costa Rica takes us to the middle of the jungle between snakes and wild animals as the group chase after jaguars in the wild depth of the tropical landscape. They will go against fast waters, challenge heat and cold waters and enjoy a trip of a lifetime.Join them in Chasing Jaguars, on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup - Slalom 3 World Cup Tacen
programme.desc: We are in stage three of the Canoe Slalom World Cup, and this time we will be competing on the water of Ljubljana, in Tacen. The racing conditions are perfect and we are focused on the final: men will be competing in C1 and women in K1. Matej Benus who was leading the standings in the men's category will not be competing in the final, so Benjamin Savsek has a chance to step up in the podium. Relive the best moments of the third stage of the 2018 Canoe Slalom World Cup in Tacen.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup - Slalom 4 World Cup Markkleeberg
programme.desc: We are in Markkleeberg, Germany, for round four of the 2019 ICF Canoe Slalom World Cup. This is the third time this venue hosts a World Cup, and 183 athletes from 26 countries have enrolled, competing for points across the five-race World Cup. As we are a month away from the olympic qualifiers and World Championships in Spain, we are ready for a sharp end of the 2019 international racing season. Discover the best moments in Markkleeberg on Nautical Channel!

programme.title: Bass By Kayak
programme.desc: Bass by Kayak follows a small expedition party formed by four adventurers crossing from the Australian mainland to Tasmania in sea kayaks. With a 300 km separation, a bare four hundred people have made the crossing of the Bass Strait in the modern era. Before then, Aboriginal Australians sailed in their canoes the shocking distance during the last ice age.This adventure makes strategic stops on the islands along the way; however, it is one of the toughest and deadliest journeys in the world. Adventure filmmaker Beau Miles narrates the expedition as the first ever feature film of the crossing via sea kayaks.The travellers will experience chafe, storms, bad cooking and an emerging mate-ship between men that barely know each other.Watch it now with Nautical Channel.

programme.title: GKA Kite World Tour Summaries - Episode 6
Qatar Airways GKA Kite World Tour Magazines - Episode 2
Tahitian Swell
programme.desc: The French Polynesia is world famous not only for its clear blue waters, but also for the quality of its waves to the delight of worldwide surfers. These waves are generated by the swell; an undulating movement of the sea surface that advances as it does not break.If the French Polynesia is one of the kingdoms of surfing, it is thanks to its geographical location. Nestled in the heart of the South Pacific, this group of five archipelagos cover an area as vast as Europe and benefit all year round from swells generated by the four winds.The conditions are therefore ideal for the many wave lovers: surfers, windsurfers, bodyboarders... but in order for them to enjoy these conditions, knowledge of marine forecasting is essential. This is where the Polynesian branch of Météo France takes place, including amongst their team swell specialists as Kenji Flohr, a Polynesian forecaster and surfer.His mission is to anticipate the waves that will break on the Polynesian coasts, by analysing the swells, their direction, period, energy, length, and dimensions. The expertise of this surfer forecaster enables to popularize a set of advanced analyses. This makes this didactic documentary accessible to all. And thanks to Kenji Flohr’s crystal clear explanations like the water of the Pacific Ocean, this complex system becomes clear and above all… fascinating.Learn more about the Tahitian Swell and the scientific approach for predicting waves, available on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: The Boat Show - Episode 7
programme.desc: The first Chris Craft boat was built by Christopher Colombus Smith in 1874, and since the brand has left its mark on many. Now we have the chance to try the Capri 27, built with modern materials but the same care and precision as the old master carpenters. Then, we will discover Eleva Yachts in the Marina degli Aregai before getting onboard the Benetti 125 Rolls Royce Azipull. Come join us!

programme.title: The Boat Show - Episode 8
programme.desc: In today's episode of The Boat Show we get on board a really special superyacht. Built by Benetti and propulsed by Rolls Royce we are on board the Benetti 125 Fast. Then, we get on board the Azimut S6 to remember the sport factor in a luxury yacht. Come join us on board!

programme.title: Beneath the Surface
programme.desc: Big wave surfer Andrew Cotton, a plumber and father of two from Devon, hit the headlines in 2014 when it was rumoured that he had surfed the world’s biggest wave, estimated at 80ft. In this one-off 30-minute documentary, Andrew and his team of surfers, sailors and adventurers put everything on hold as they secretly chase a wave that emerges only a handful of times each year, giving only hours of warning.Taking a boat eight miles off the coast of Ireland, the team battle the extreme cold and fierce weather conditions, whilst mapping the ocean’s swell, in order to try to catch one almighty ride. Far from home and with the days getting shorter, frustration sets in, as the window of opportunity gets smaller. With a young family at home, Andrew must balance the normality of the school run, before boarding a plane alone to face one of earth’s deadliest monsters.

Wild Surf - Episode 3
programme.desc: In this episode of Wild Surf, we’re in the Mentawai islands in Indonesia for ‘Morning Glory’, a documentary featuring eight French surfers as they head to the islands in search of the perfect surf. Featuring surfers Marc Lacomare, Benjamin Sanchis, Alain Riou, Naum Ildefonse, Romain Cloitre, Jason Aparicio and Charly Martin, Morning Glory takes us on a journey through some of the best waves in the islands. From the infamous Greenbush to the little known Roxy, this is the surfing trip of a lifetime.

programme.title: Wild Surf - Episode 4
programme.desc: A packed episode for you, with footage from the Nixon Surf Challenge, the story of MS surfboards and ‘Away’ - an amazing short documentary about three women who surf in New York City. The Nixon surf challenge has been going on for a decade now. The event has grown from a casual get together of befriended riders, into the annual trip it is today.

programme.title: Who is Vilayta
programme.desc: WHO IS VILAYTA reveals the nature of Vilayta, one of the pioneers of big wave surfing on the Canary Islands. This short biographical documentary shares with us his deep connection with the ocean and Germán Pinelo captures this perfectly in this impressive world.This short documentary is full of unrepeatable moments. Filled with people who love what they do, that do not stop dreaming and living life how they want to. Combining passions, dreams, friendship, craziness and sweetness, Who is Vilayta deepens the character beyond the figure of the surfer. An artful motion picture that breaks myth and makes legends.

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise - Ep.6 - NIN - PAG
The Barrel
programme.desc: Since the first wave was ridden, surfers have shared stories and experiences to try to explain the wonders inside the waves they ride.Professional and amateur surfers, photographers and videographers around the world have the possibility to display their passion: Barrel surfing. This term is used by surfers to describe riding well inside the curve of a finely shaped breaking wave, for many described as magical.The Barrel is all about surfer’s skills, creativity and love for adventure as they look for the best waves for tube riding. Get inside the barrel of the wave, with Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 1 - Dubrovnik – Lastovo

programme.title: VOR Supremacy
programme.desc: The Volvo Ocean Race sails around 10 cities from all over the world, making it the ultimate test for sailors. Often described as the longest and toughest professional sporting event in the world, it is one of the sport’s big three events, alongside the Olympic Games and America’s Cup.The cannon blast in Alicante sends off the fleet, and once again shakes the sailing world. The veterans finally get their memory back while for the rookies it feels like mission impossible. They share the same obsession for the sea, and many of them have fully dedicated themselves for years, even decades trying to win it.The 2017-18 edition of the Volvo Ocean Race sets sail around the globe. The challenge is full on, and now they are all going rogue.

programme.title: Inside Sailing - Episode 11
programme.desc: We begin our journey on Italy’s Lake Garda with the hottest foiling action and the latest GC32 Racing Tour event, the GC32 Riva Cup. After the spectacular GC32 we stay with high performance yachts and we travel to Cascais in Portugal for the 44Cup. Then, we’ll take you to Turkey for the 2019 Turkcell Platinum Bosphorus Cup. Finally, we get the chance to admire the historic Dragon boats in action. The International Dragon 90th Anniversary Regatta brought together teams from all over the world in order to celebrate and compete in these beautiful boats.

programme.title: Star Sailors League - Episode 1
programme.desc: From wily old sea dogs to the latest fresh-faced talent – the top talent in sailing sport take to the warm, azure blue waters of Nassau’s Montagu Bay for the Star Sailors League Finals, to determine the world’s greatest sailor: the ‘star’ of sailing.

programme.title: The Ocean Race - Leg 1 Alicante - HL
Clipper: The Race Of Their Lives - Episode 2
programme.desc: The Clipper Race crews are in Uruguay and celebrate a wonderful visit with a spectacular send-off. One crew has suffered a dramatic incident in the middle of the night, and there is a tragedy that will affect everyone involved in the race. Find out now how the challengers will overcome their obstacles in one of the toughest nautical competitions around the globe.

programme.title: Who is Vilayta
programme.desc: WHO IS VILAYTA reveals the nature of Vilayta, one of the pioneers of big wave surfing on the Canary Islands. This short biographical documentary shares with us his deep connection with the ocean and Germán Pinelo captures this perfectly in this impressive world.This short documentary is full of unrepeatable moments. Filled with people who love what they do, that do not stop dreaming and living life how they want to. Combining passions, dreams, friendship, craziness and sweetness, Who is Vilayta deepens the character beyond the figure of the surfer. An artful motion picture that breaks myth and makes legends.

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise - Ep.6 - NIN - PAG
Reaching Reality - Episode 1 - Origin
programme.desc: From under the Golden Gate Bridge down to the Santa Cruz Islands the three friends and their little boat are now heading south. However bad weather is on the horizon and signs that the film and the filmmaker are already thinking about abandoning ship are starting to leak through. After a long night of sea sickness, it’s time to face reality and see who’s going to stick around and who’s going to go.

programme.title: Reaching Reality - Episode 2 - Reality
programme.desc: Now closing in on Mexico and having spent nearly a month at sea, the crew are facing some realities they didn’t expect. It’s cold, it’s wet, and its nothing like what they were hoping. Adding to the chaos, Barry is emotionally lost and opens up about what he left behind to go on this trip. As the crew pokes around Catalina Island and down into Mexico a reckoning with what the trip is and what they wanted it to be is on the horizon and with it a new reality of life.

Inside Kiel - Sailing Capital and more
programme.desc: Kiel is the nautical epicentre of Germany, and the proud host of the world's biggest sailing event, the Kieler Woche. From learning how to sail a Formula18 catamaran to exploring local kitesurf spots and shipyards, Nautical Channel host Lucia Metzbauer will be there, diving into the local nautical scene and finding out why there are so many young sailors in Kiel.Join her in Kieler Woche, one of the largest sailing events in the world. With regattas sailing at the highest level and an unbeatable class diversity, entertainment is secured as we learn everything about this German event that drives the attention of sailors worldwide.

programme.title: The Ocean Race - Leg 1 Alicante - HL
Wind Masters - Episode 8: Rab, Mali Lošinj, Cres
The Irish Gathering
programme.desc: The Nautical Channel team travels to Ireland to meet up with the Gathering Cruise at Kinsale. We will be discovering the sailing and culture of the West Coast as we meet up the gathering cruise, visit a classic boat regatta and sample some delicious Irish gourmet meals. However, the trip will take a turn as rough seas and strong wind turn their leisure cruise into a rescue operation. Will our crew be okay in the Irish cold waters? Let's find out in The Irish Gathering!

programme.title: Screen Heroes - Episode 2
programme.desc: Welcome to today's episode of Screen Heroes! We are in San Sebastian, not only one of Spain's most beautiful cities, but also home to one of the most important surfing festivals in the world. Then, we get transported to the African coastline with The African Project before returning to San Sebastian to discover what's inside the Teatro Principal.

programme.title: Ocean Safari - Kenya - Episode 2
programme.desc: In this episode, Andi will discover the diverse marine ecosystem of Kilifi Creek. She will learn how to sail in three days in order to truly experience the creek. Andi goes 3 degrees south to meet Kevin, a local sailor who patiently teaches Andi the skills she needs in this short span of time. A true local experience is waiting if she can complete her training but failure is always lurking.

programme.title: Reaching Reality - Episode 3 - Freedom
programme.desc: Deeper south into the Baja Peninsula, the weather has calm and sunny days are more common. As we open the episode with the boat breaking free from being trapped by an anchor locked in the reef, there is a new sense of freedom. On the horizon are rare and never-before seen islands with beached seals, isolated lighthouse keepers, and massive salt mines. As they discover the new and uncharted, word comes in that surf is coming and now the race is on to get the best location to capture the incoming waves.

programme.title: Reaching Reality - Episode 4 - Discovery
programme.desc: Deep into the empty desert of Mexico’s Baja Peninsula, the three are now in pursuit of a storm swell and predictions of surf. As the head towards what’s to be an iconic moment in the trip the stop off in Tortuga Bay and have a peculiar discovery of fossilized shark’s teeth deep in the heart of this cake yellow desert. Charging south on the heals of incoming surf they land in the midst of reach surf culture and smack in the middle of society. Now after over a month in isolation the three wrestle with the experience while chasing after the best waves of the trip.

programme.title: Salon Nautique Paris - 2017
programme.desc: The Paris Boat Show is considered by the nautical industry one of the most important venues in the field. For the passionate French public, this event is an absolute must, and we agree there is no other place like the Paris Nautic as France is possibly the greatest boating nation on the world. Thousands are expected to arrive on the 3rd of December until the following weekend, and fans will be storming the pavillions of Porte de Versailles for the latest innovation and best deals. Are you going to miss it? Come join us, on Nautical Channel!

programme.title: Jump On Board - Episode 2
programme.desc: In this episode of Jump on Board, the girls and I will sail from Corfu to Paxos, the island created by Poseidon according to Greek mythology when he struck his trident on Corfu, breaking it in two. Let's hope that Linda, Cindy and Caitlin don't divide like the islands as they get to know each other better. Jump on board with us to find out!

We will be discovering the sailing and culture of the West Coast as we meet up the gathering cruise, visit a classic boat regatta and sample some delicious Irish gourmet meals. However, the trip will take a turn as rough seas and strong wind turn their leisure cruise into a rescue operation. Will our crew be okay in the Irish cold waters? Let's find out in The Irish Gathering!

programme.title: Reaching Reality - Episode 3 - Freedom
programme.desc: Deeper south into the Baja Peninsula, the weather has calm and sunny days are more common. As we open the episode with the boat breaking free from being trapped by an anchor locked in the reef, there is a new sense of freedom. On the horizon are rare and never-before seen islands with beached seals, isolated lighthouse keepers, and massive salt mines. As they discover the new and uncharted, word comes in that surf is coming and now the race is on to get the best location to capture the incoming waves.

programme.title: Reaching Reality - Episode 4 - Discovery
programme.desc: Deep into the empty desert of Mexico’s Baja Peninsula, the three are now in pursuit of a storm swell and predictions of surf. As the head towards what’s to be an iconic moment in the trip the stop off in Tortuga Bay and have a peculiar discovery of fossilized shark’s teeth deep in the heart of this cake yellow desert. Charging south on the heals of incoming surf they land in the midst of reach surf culture and smack in the middle of society. Now after over a month in isolation the three wrestle with the experience while chasing after the best waves of the trip.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup - Slalom 3 World Cup Tacen
programme.desc: We are in stage three of the Canoe Slalom World Cup, and this time we will be competing on the water of Ljubljana, in Tacen. The racing conditions are perfect and we are focused on the final: men will be competing in C1 and women in K1. Matej Benus who was leading the standings in the men's category will not be competing in the final, so Benjamin Savsek has a chance to step up in the podium. Relive the best moments of the third stage of the 2018 Canoe Slalom World Cup in Tacen.

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise - Ep.6 - NIN - PAG
Sylt - The Queen Of The North Sea
programme.desc: Welcome to Sylt! The northernmost island of Germany spreads for 40 kilometers and has been since ages a top nautical location. All year round you can find action here at the North Sea, and Nautical Channel host Lucia Metzbauer is ready to disembark in this location and explore the queen of the North Sea with our team. She will meet the locals, get to know the hidden gems, the best places for surfing and sailing, discover the wildlife and explore the enormous PWA Grand Slam in Sylt – the windsurfing event to be! Get ready to dive into Sylt's secrets as we wander around an UNESCO World Heritage Site and get splashed with the windsurf action. Let's get going to Sylt - The Queen of the North Sea!

programme.title: The Road To Bermuda - Episode 3
programme.desc: It's a new year, so what kind of resolutions have the America's Cup athletes made? And what's the local hangover cure for too much Bermudan rum? Find out in episode 3 of Road to Bermuda! We take look at the the regatta of 2015, before celebrating the start of the New Year with the local cocktail: dark ‘n’ stormies. Finally, we make sure we start the year in a good mood with the happiest man on the island, Johnny Barnes.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 2 - Korcula – Stari Grad
programme.desc: Korcula is often referred as a little Dubrovnik and we will show you why is that. We will taste some amazing cuisine and attend Moreska dance that is preserved from the Middle Ages and it is performed only here on island of Korcula. After Korcula we visit beautiful Stari Grad town on the island of Hvar and wonder it's amazing old streets.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 3 - Vrboska - Split
programme.desc: Small city of Vrboska is a little piece of paradise for yachtsmen and Split is the biggest city in Dalmatia. We will show you where to go, what to see, and of course, some amazing food suggestions.

programme.title: Brilliant Corners Barbados
programme.desc: The Caribbean is filled with places where tourism is rare or close to non-existent. However, there is so much potential for cultural and water sports tourism, they are called Brilliant corners. Nautical Channel is on a mission to explore the brilliant corners of the Caribbean.Going from Haiti all the way to Jamaica or Barbados, we will dive into these brilliant corners, many of them with no tourism at all. With a sustainable tourism approach, get ready to live a fully local experience on Brilliant Corners Barbados while we practice water sports, taste the traditional local dishes and talk with the habitants of the area.On this occasion, we venture into Barbados: an eastern Caribbean island with colonial buildings, botanical gardens and 17th century plantation houses. Join Sam Bleakly, a travel writer, surfer, and a lecturer in cultural tourism, as he takes you under the skin of the coastline and inner parts of Barbados.

programme.title: Cannes Yachting Festival - Episode 1

programme.title: Locked In
programme.desc: Located just a few degrees south of the equator, Papua New Guinea is a tapestry of virgin rainforest, unique cultures and an expansive coastline. Pouring out of its ‘Nakanai Plateau’ is the Beriman River. Over 40km in length from source to sea, it drops more than 2,000m before reaching the Solomon Sea.The Beriman Gorge’s mysterious and towering canyon walls have never before been explored. Kayakers Ben Stookesberry, Chris Korbulic, Ben Marr and Pedro Oliva set out to conquer these previously unchartered whitewater rapids.This is one of kayaking’s most significant challenges and during the 13-day expedition, their skills and patience are pushed to their limits. They navigate twelve distinct gorges, numerous class-5 rapids, inescapable vertical walls, fluctuating water levels and dense jungle cover. All of these untamed natural obstacles stand in the way of the quartet’s successful first descent.

Wild Surf - Episode 5
programme.desc: Starting the show we take a look at how the charity One Wave uses surfing and the power of the ocean to transform lives. Next, we take in more breath taking scenery from down under and uncover the surfing scene at some of the most notorious beaches in Australia.  Lastly, we check out some thrilling stand-up paddle surfing and follow the adventures of two brothers and surfing professionals, on their global search to discover the perfect wave.

programme.title: Wild Surf - Episode 6
programme.desc: This week we’ve got a special episode featuring every surfers most feared predator – the shark. We’re speaking with our friends at the SeaLife London Aquarium, as well as pro surfers, Mick Fanning & Kelly Slater. We’ll be taking a look at the latest shark prevention technology, as well as the rescue teams who are keeping surfers safe from sharks. Plus, we’ve got a profile of Markus, a really talented shaper.

programme.title: Untouched Waters In Turkmenistan
programme.desc: Welcome to the eastern coast of the Caspian sea. Turkmenistan, Avasa, is known for its desert and not so much for its nautical resort. Nonetheless, Turkmenistan is hosting the PWA World Cup 2014 right here. Nautical Channel host Nikolai Berger explores the untouched waters of the Caspian Sea to discover the first time ever of the PWA Windsurfing World Cup. How will the best windsurfers in the world handle this challenging and unexplored location? Will Antoine Albeau’s brute force triumph again? Find out if the Caspian Sea can become one of the new exciting locations, with just the right wind conditions for this world class in Untouched Waters in Turkmenistan. Only on Nautical Channel.

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise - Ep.7 - NOVALJA - RAB
Skagerrak
programme.desc: SKAGERRAK follows the preparation and mental development of the Danish professional stand up paddle athlete Casper Steinfath in his attempt to be the first person in the world to paddle from Denmark to Norway.In his journey, brotherhood and friendship come to play an essential part making a dream and project like the crossing of an entire ocean come true. SKAGERRAK will take you behind the scenes of mainstream media and portrays the Northern and secluded region of Denmark called Thy, where Casper grew up.A region, where a pioneer spirit and desire for independence prevails despite adversity and isolation. SKAGERRAK is an inspirational story that touches upon the dreams, aspirations, and desires that live inside all of us. A film about the courage to reach for the horizon.

programme.title: Rolex Spirit Of Yachting - Ep1 - Rolex China Sea Race
The Ocean Race - Leg 2 Cap Town - HL
Wind Masters - Episode 9:NP Brijuni, Rovinj, Poreč, Vrsar, Novigrad
Rios Patagonicos
programme.desc: 15 canyoneers go on a life-changing expedition to discover the immensity of Chilean Patagonia in search for untouched territories, rivers and waterfalls organised by the Regard sur l’Aventure association. Their goal: to explore this mysterious land and spot and open over 30 canyons on a land where canyoneering is close to non-existent.For some, Rios Patagonicos is the opportunity to go on an expedition for the first time. For more skilled canyoneers, it is the occasion to share their experience on a tricky terrain. However, all of them will have to cooperate and share a common desire: the thrill of unveiling the unknown in a trip that awakes fear and team spirit.Awards:Finalist – Everest International Film Festival 2020. Finalist – The Taste Awards 2020. Finalist Best Sport Film – Flicks Film Festival 2019. Best Short Documentary – Panama International Film Festival 2019, Maracay International Film Festival 2019, Short Film Factory 2019. Semi-Finalist – New Harvest Film Festival 2019. Official Selections 2020: ATFF Costwolds, Trieste Int Mountain Film Festival, Naturetrack Film Festival, Mammoth Film Festival, Backpacklight Adventure Film Festival, Frozen River Film Festival, PIMFF etc. Official Selections 2019: Bansko, Explorimage, Festival du Film de Montagne, FICTS, Winter Film Festival, Rome Independent Prisma Awards, Sestriere Film Festival, Ember Aquatics Int Film Festival, Explos, Int Nature Film Festival Godollo, Les Escales Voyageuses, Rencontres du Film de Montagne, Adventure Shorts Film Festival, Big Water Film Festival, Action! Int Film Festival, Mountain & Adventure Film Festival, Vertical Life Film Festival, Veracruz Short Film Festival, Montevideo Int Film Festival, Inca Int Film Festival, BangkokThai Int Film Festival etc.

programme.title: Screen Heroes - Episode 3
programme.desc: On this episode, we are going to check out the Surf at Lisbon Film Fest in Portugal. Lisbon has a lot more to offer than just world-class waves, and we are ready to dive into the film action. Come join us as we visit this important surfing festival and take a close look behind the scenes!

programme.title: Ocean Safari - Kenya - Episode 3
programme.desc: We venture into Kenya’s wild coastline in the Watamu region. This Marine reserve is incredibly unique and in order for Andi to truly experience it she has to learn to kite surf in a very short period of time. She needs help, so she decides to track down the Tribe Watersports and Ben Kelliher who will guide her through a crash course in kitesurfing. If she can do it in the allocated time, Ben has an incredible prize waiting for her.

programme.title: Reaching Reality - Episode 5 - Return
programme.desc: After nearly two months at sea, which now seems like lifetimes compounded by the suffering and challenge of the passage. The three are closing out their trip home and saving the best for last. Shocked by what seems to be death island, the three uncover shark hunters and in their last village before departure battle to resupply with the essentials of gas and water with the last pennies on the boat. Meanwhile the struggles of our filmmaker’s journey return along with the fear of going back to all that was left behind.

programme.title: Julbo Sail Session
programme.desc: The mythical, legendary Cape Horn towers high in the imagination of all sailors. Located in the southern part of the Patagonia, sailors will travel from Usuaïa to Cap Horn. Passing it is always a feat so you can imagine the adventure two men set out for themselves when they dreamed of being the ﬁrst to pass it in a Nacra.Aboard a flying catamaran, the Julbo Session is a unique event that requires constant attention. The situation at the Julbo Sail season is tense and things become serious as the sailors have to push forward whatever happens, as the weather window is very brief and they have little time to succeed in their adventure.Embark on this journey across la Tierra del Fuego, a mystical place with extraordinary landscapes and incredible shifts in weather that allowed sailors in the Nacra to achieve a lifetime dream: pass Cape Horn aboard a flying catamaran.

programme.title: Salon Nautique Paris - 2018
programme.desc: The Nautic Paris International Boat Show returns in 2018 to welcome hundreds of nautical enthusiasts inside its doors. We will be able to find out the latest trends in nautical equipment, sailing vessels, superyachts or rental services. Are you ready to discover the latest in the nautical industry? Come dive with us in the 2018 Salon Nautique Paris.

programme.title: Jump On Board - Episode 3
programme.desc: In this new episode of Jump on Board, Cindy, Linda and Caitlin sail from Paxos to Lefkada, the island of the ladies where Aphrodite was born and the Greek poet Sappho jumped from the cliffs to her death. Either the ladies will find love or misfortune this time, so let's find out on Jump on Board!

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise - Ep.7 - NOVALJA - RAB
The Cyclades With Andi Van Zyl - Ios
programme.desc: Andi van Zyl is in Ios Island at the time the Meltemi winds start, and she is ready to enjoy watersports both above and below the surface. Andi will understand the significance this island has on its habitants when she discovers what is believed to be the tomb of Homer: the creator of the Iliad and the Odyssey. This is our final stop in this journey around the Cyclades, so Andi is ready to make the most of it.

programme.title: The Road To Bermuda - Episode 4
programme.desc: The February episode is Valentine’s Day themed! We meet the new members of SoftBank Team Japan and find out what it takes to make it onto the team, as well as their thoughts on love. Then, we get an exclusive look at the site of the AC35 Event Village, and take the ultimate challenge – trying out for Bermuda’s Red Bull Youth America’s Cup team.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 4 - Zagreb
programme.desc: The capital of Croatia Zagreb is a not-to-miss destination, no matter if you arrive by boat, car or airplane. Only 1 hour from the coast it is definitely worth a visit. Most important attractions and some crazy museums will amaze you. There is also an interesting connection between Zagreb and nautics and we will reveal it all to you.

programme.title: Sail-Ho - Episode 5 - Solta – Sibenik
programme.desc: The island of Solta is one of the most beautiful islands in the Central Dalmatia and we visited some very interesting places and coves. Sibenik is a city with many fortresses, old churches and UNESCO heritage. See it all in this episode.

programme.title: Brilliant Corners Haiti
programme.desc: The Caribbean is filled with places where tourism is rare or close to non-existent. However, there is so much potential for cultural and water sports tourism, they are called Brilliant corners. Nautical Channel is on a mission to explore the brilliant corners of the Caribbean.Going from Haiti all the way to Jamaica or Barbados, we will dive into these brilliant corners, many of them with no tourism at all. With a sustainable tourism approach, get ready to live a fully local experience on Brilliant Corners Haiti while we practice water sports, taste the traditional local dishes and talk with the habitants of the area.On this occasion, we venture into Haiti: the Caribbean country that shares the island of Hispaniola with the Dominican Republic. Many of Haiti’s landmarks date to the early 19th century, and despite still recovering from the earthquake of 2010, Haiti is a beautiful paradise for many visitors.Join Sam Bleakly, a travel writer, surfer, and a lecturer in cultural tourism, as he takes you under the skin of the coastline and inner parts of Haiti. Experience the Haitians history, art, culture, music, food, landscape, and their coastline as Sam leads you through what he calls, the off-beat track locations of the brilliant corners of the world.

programme.title: Cannes Yachting Festival - Episode 1
programme.desc: The glamorous city of Cannes hosts the luxury Yachting Festival par excellence for the 40th time this year and a new Luxury Gallery has been opened in the Palais de Festivals to celebrate this landmark anniversary. Breathe in the boat show’s opulence and learn about the latest trends in the yachting world!

programme.title: Surf Ski - Episode 1 - Perth
programme.desc: Welcome to Perth, Australia for the Surfski World Tour. Will he win again in Perth? Let's find out on Surf Ski!

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup - Slalom 1 World Cup Ljubljana
programme.desc: Ljubljana is the chosen scenery for the Slalom World Cup. The slovenian capital will bring the top kayakers who will navigate the whitewater course passing through a series of combination of upstream and downstream gates. The fastest to achieve this will become the champion of the World Cup. Find out now what will happen in Ljubljana in the exciting Slalom World Cup!

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup - Slalom 2 World Cup Pau
programme.desc: The Slalom World Cup series of 2020 continue in Pau. In the south of France, just 85km from the Spanish border, the kayakers will challenge themselves to this slalom competition. They want to become the best of the world in this Olympic discipline. Find out now who will be at the podium of the Slalom World Cup in Pau.

programme.title: Dusi Canoe Marathon - Episode 1
programme.desc: Join host Andi van Zyl in South Africa for one of the toughest canoe races in the world! The Dusi Canoe Marathon famously pits competitors against powerful rapids and unpredictable wildlife, and the 2014 edition will feature SUP riders for the first time in the event’s history. Are you ready for all its action? Discover the 2014 Dusi Canoe Marathon on Nautical Channel!

programme.title: Wind Masters - Episode 9:NP Brijuni, Rovinj, Poreč, Vrsar, Novigrad
Rios Patagonicos
programme.desc: 15 canyoneers go on a life-changing expedition to discover the immensity of Chilean Patagonia in search for untouched territories, rivers and waterfalls organised by the Regard sur l’Aventure association. Their goal: to explore this mysterious land and spot and open over 30 canyons on a land where canyoneering is close to non-existent.For some, Rios Patagonicos is the opportunity to go on an expedition for the first time. For more skilled canyoneers, it is the occasion to share their experience on a tricky terrain. However, all of them will have to cooperate and share a common desire: the thrill of unveiling the unknown in a trip that awakes fear and team spirit.Awards:Finalist – Everest International Film Festival 2020. Finalist – The Taste Awards 2020. Finalist Best Sport Film – Flicks Film Festival 2019. Best Short Documentary – Panama International Film Festival 2019, Maracay International Film Festival 2019, Short Film Factory 2019. Semi-Finalist – New Harvest Film Festival 2019. Official Selections 2020: ATFF Costwolds, Trieste Int Mountain Film Festival, Naturetrack Film Festival, Mammoth Film Festival, Backpacklight Adventure Film Festival, Frozen River Film Festival, PIMFF etc. Official Selections 2019: Bansko, Explorimage, Festival du Film de Montagne, FICTS, Winter Film Festival, Rome Independent Prisma Awards, Sestriere Film Festival, Ember Aquatics Int Film Festival, Explos, Int Nature Film Festival Godollo, Les Escales Voyageuses, Rencontres du Film de Montagne, Adventure Shorts Film Festival, Big Water Film Festival, Action! Int Film Festival, Mountain & Adventure Film Festival, Vertical Life Film Festival, Veracruz Short Film Festival, Montevideo Int Film Festival, Inca Int Film Festival, BangkokThai Int Film Festival etc.

programme.title: Reaching Reality - Episode 5 - Return
programme.desc: After nearly two months at sea, which now seems like lifetimes compounded by the suffering and challenge of the passage. The three are closing out their trip home and saving the best for last. Shocked by what seems to be death island, the three uncover shark hunters and in their last village before departure battle to resupply with the essentials of gas and water with the last pennies on the boat. Meanwhile the struggles of our filmmaker’s journey return along with the fear of going back to all that was left behind.

programme.title: Julbo Sail Session
programme.desc: The mythical, legendary Cape Horn towers high in the imagination of all sailors. Located in the southern part of the Patagonia, sailors will travel from Usuaïa to Cap Horn. Passing it is always a feat so you can imagine the adventure two men set out for themselves when they dreamed of being the ﬁrst to pass it in a Nacra.Aboard a flying catamaran, the Julbo Session is a unique event that requires constant attention. The situation at the Julbo Sail season is tense and things become serious as the sailors have to push forward whatever happens, as the weather window is very brief and they have little time to succeed in their adventure.Embark on this journey across la Tierra del Fuego, a mystical place with extraordinary landscapes and incredible shifts in weather that allowed sailors in the Nacra to achieve a lifetime dream: pass Cape Horn aboard a flying catamaran.

programme.title: Untouched Waters In Turkmenistan
programme.desc: Welcome to the eastern coast of the Caspian sea. Turkmenistan, Avasa, is known for its desert and not so much for its nautical resort. Find out if the Caspian Sea can become one of the new exciting locations, with just the right wind conditions for this world class in Untouched Waters in Turkmenistan. Only on Nautical Channel.

programme.desc: Thanks to the famed Atlantic swells that roll along its coastline and despite being home to just 650 people, this watersports mecca attracts surfers and windsurfers from across the world. programme.title: P1 USA AquaX - Episode 2 Cocoa Beach, FL
programme.desc: The AquaX competition continues its Round 2 on Cocoa Beach, Florida. Jet skies rush into the water at vertiginous speeds in the latest competition of the Championship. So far, challengers have only tested the water once, but they know the level is high and they will have to give their all in this competition in order to win. Find out what happens at Cocoa Beach.

programme.title: Up the Creek
programme.desc: There's only one boat race in the world where two-man teams blast up southern Australia's Murray River in aluminium dinghies at speeds of over 80kph. This river is not only known for dividing Victoria from New South Wales and for being Australia’s longest river, but also for being full of dangerous obstacles.Up the Creek challenges competing teams to speed up Murray River’s challenging water in a competition like no other. Find out now what will happen in this competition that explores Australia’s nature in depth, on Nautical Channel.

Find out if the Caspian Sea can become one of the new exciting locations, with just the right wind conditions for this world class in Untouched Waters in Turkmenistan. Only on Nautical Channel.

Wild Surf - Episode 7
programme.desc: In this episode, we’re in Nias, an idyllic island off the western coast of Sumatra in Indonesia. The island’s Lagundri Bay is world famous for its towering, lengthy barrels. We’re following the exploits of one Luke Dillon, an extremely promising, young, Cornish surfer, who made the trip with fellow Cornishman Jim Bergin, and photographer Paul Terry.

programme.title: Wild Surf - Episode 8
programme.desc: In this episode, we’re starting off in Denmark with one of the hottest places to go surfing in the world right now, Klitmøller, aka Cold Hawaii. We’re keeping it chilly as we head to California for the Coldwater Classic. Then, the Surfing 4 Peace collective are bringing people together through this wonderful sport. Young filmmaker Jesper Jungell is then going to be introducing us to the breaks of California. Finally, we’re reporting on the monster El Niño swell that is currently hurtling towards Southern California.

programme.title: What Sup - Episode 1
programme.desc: In this first episode of What SUP we meet David Brent and go paddleboarding for a chat on the water. He will talk about his experience on the stage before trying out the popular paddleboard yoga with Winny Clarke. We will hopefully learn how to relax on the water and not fall out of our boards too much!

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise - Ep.8 - LOŠINJ - CRES
Of Men and Mavericks
programme.desc: After getting inspired by Chasing Mavericks, a movie featuring Gerard Butler, Of Men and Mavericks covers the story of surfing legends like Peter Mel, Jeff Clark and Mark Foo in their attempts to surf mavericks. They recount their first ventures in the Half Moon Bay spot and how they managed to conquer waves that reached more than 8 meters of height.Their perseverance, enthusiasm and willingness got them time after time into the cold waters of San Francisco to attempt a dangerous task that could have fatal repercussions. Their goal: to surf some of the biggest waves in the world.Follow the path of these brave surfers who leave it all behind to surf big waves, on Nautical Channel.
